description: This file implements a network management plugin with JSON-RPC methods, event subscriptions, and internal logic for handling network interfaces, IP settings, connectivity, and related events within the WPEFramework environment.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class that executes a provided function.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the network plugin, sets environment, and subscribes to network events.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops timers, and unregisters methods.

methods.name: registerLegacyMethods
methods.description: Registers JSON-RPC methods for network operations.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to network events such as interface changes and IP address updates.

methods.name: ReportonInterfaceStateChange
methods.description: Handles and reports interface state change events.

methods.name: ReportonActiveInterfaceChange
methods.description: Handles and reports active interface change events.

methods.name: ReportonIPAddressChange
methods.description: Handles and reports IP address change events.

methods.name: ReportonInternetStatusChange
methods.description: Handles and reports internet status change events.
